contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ PAX PVBLICA ; D/ FL IVL HE-LENAE AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena. AD337-340, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads PAX PVBLICA. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Mint is Trier. See RIC VIII, p.143, nos.47/63. Obverse shows Draped bust right. Obverse legend reads FL IVL HE-LENAE AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //.TRS[...] . Condition is very fine.
